svg.aria-label: Fig 1, head direction picks the display. A sighting turret on a rotary base stands in for the user's head. Its yaw circle is engraved every 2 degrees and carries two calibration stops, the MacBook at -4 degrees and the LG monitor at +28 degrees, with a hysteresis band around the +12 degree midpoint. The turret is turned to +27 degrees and its dwell gauge is full, so the LG monitor's screen is lit and holds the pointer, while the MacBook's screen stays dark.
